title: Bonus Review Span on Savings Accounts Still Building Their Balance
content:
The bonus review span of a savings or money market account of Savings & Money Market Accounts is lengthened for accounts still building their balance. Two facts decide it: the count of deposits posted to the account in the three calendar months ending on the review date, and the whole months the account has been open.

- **3 or more deposits in that window, and the account open no more than 12 whole months** — the bonus review span is 90 days.
- **Exactly 2 deposits in that window, and the account open no more than 12 whole months** — the bonus review span is 60 days.
- **Fewer than 2 deposits in that window, or the account open more than 12 whole months** — the bonus review span is the 31 days of the closed statement month.

### Points of judgement

*Does a high deposit count lengthen the span on an older account?* No. The age condition and the deposit condition must both hold. An account open 20 whole months takes the 31 days of the closed statement month however many deposits posted in the window.

*What of an account open 4 whole months with a single deposit in the window?* The deposit count falls below 2, so the span is again the 31 days of the closed statement month.

*Where do the boundaries fall?* An account open exactly 12 whole months on the review date still satisfies the age condition; one open 13 whole months does not. A count of exactly 3 deposits gives 90 days and a count of exactly 2 gives 60 days.
